'''Woern's Pirates''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band led by the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Laerron Woern]], based on [["Woern's Asteroid"|Woern's Asteroid]] in the [[Drup's Star system/Legends|Drup's Star system]]. Woern commanded a sizable pirate fleet of modified [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], and over two hundred pirates including [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], Elomin, and [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Woern's command vessel was a modified [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]]. The pirate's main targets were lightly defended cargo fleets, unarmed [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liners]], and large civilian cargo [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. Although they were generally indiscriminate in choosing their targets, in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] Woern purchased [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] trade route information and began hitting New Republic shipping exclusively.
